capabilities: Render a life-in-weeks grid where each cell opens or creates the matching weekly note
Open, create and preview daily notes via a long-press day view and hover tooltips
Manage multiple timelines as tabs with their own start dates, legends and daily-note folders
Edit many weeks at once with multi-select, colors, titles and quick-edit
Compute and mark life milestones such as 10,000 days or 1,000 weeks per tab
extras: Legend and tab settings are stored in a normal Markdown note ({base folder}/Life in Weeks Config.md) so they sync across devices; on simultaneous edits, the last sync wins. Weekly note YAML labels remain in German for historical reasons.
problem: Obsidian creates daily and weekly notes but has no visual calendar that maps the weeks of a life onto those notes for journaling and tracking.
